label: Virginia: applicability
note: Verified editorial summary, not a verbatim statutory extract. Primary text retrieved for the September 22, 2026 applicability candidate. Current code retrieved September 22, 2026; no future applicability amendment applied.
body: Does it conduct business in Virginia OR produce products or services targeted to Virginia residents?

Does it control or process at least 100,000 consumers’ personal data during a calendar year; OR control or process at least 25,000 consumers’ personal data AND derive strictly more than 50% of gross revenue from selling personal data?
Virginia consumers acting individually or as a household, excluding employment and commercial roles. No payment-only deduction in the 100,000 limb.
Measuring period: 100,000 limb: during a calendar year. The 25,000-plus-sale limb does not separately state a measuring period.
